story: Timer presets/controls or reserved shortcut -> typed Tauri commands -> production deadline worker -> local SQLite and scoped Notes card -> pushed countdown/completion -> compact,peek,expanded and fullscreen-policy rendering.

requirements.assertions: 25/5 and50/10 have four explicit rounds;90 is one focus without break. Custom1-1440 focus minutes,0-120 break minutes,1-12 rounds and a bounded label. Selecting settings stops/prepares; every focus/break/round starts explicitly. Pause/resume/stop and Ctrl+Alt+T toggle work through shared service.

Persist UTC deadlines and exact paused milliseconds, not renderer ticks. Complete once at original deadline after sleep/restart, with local focus_sessions history. Fixtures cover both DST transitions, rollback, running/paused/expired restarts and write-failure retry. Actual owned release restarts against its own SQLite and preserves session ID/deadline/card.

Rust worker blocks when idle/paused and until the deadline when fully hidden. Only actual visible countdown hosts/view leases tick1Hz. An eligible queued timer wakes once at59s for activity priority. Covered native hosts are excluded; destroyed WebView leases clear. No JavaScript clock, read polling or periodic SQLite writes.

Card picker uses current Notes scope and production guarded lookup. Show actual tck-N when available, open/unlink functional; local cards say Local note. Workspace switch or removed/trashed cards hides old metadata while countdown continues. Stale binding/actions are rejected. Linking/timing never edits card JSON or Tack outbox. Tack time logging is explicitly disabled forv2.1.

Production TimerEnded enters existing activity arbitration, stays queued under fullscreen silence and is rendered over fullscreen only if showAlertsOverFullscreen is enabled. Native wake uses the same production clock/power callback seam. Owned native hidden frame has every alpha byte zero; enabled completion pill is captured.
